svg.title: Server and port map
svg.desc: production physical design, 24 September 2026. Unresolved design decisions are explicitly labelled.
svg.text: Physical cabling extracted from the CSV matrices · UfiSpace ports are zero-based; Cisco ports are one-based
The backend port shown is used on every rail leaf; NIC R attaches to leaf R. Rail host address = 172.16.R.(10 + node number).
Eth1/12 (proposed) → flashblade-1 mgmt on leaf1, -2 on leaf2; 1G via QSA
On EACH backend rail leaf (800G physical ports)
Spine S ports 4 × (leaf number − 1) + [0..3] face that leaf.
51 bastion 52–53 free (FlashBlade mgmt moved to the control leaves)
10 frontend management ports (mgmt0, vPC peer-keepalive) + firewall uplink are additional.
Select OOB hardware for at least 62 logical ports, plus required spares.
Frontend uplinks require FOUR ports per leaf; exact ports unresolved.
Frontend/OOB IPs, VLANs, VNIs and ASNs to finalize.
Settled 24 Sep: backend uplinks BGP unnumbered; FlashBlade bond
as drawn; FlashBlade mgmt 1G via QSA + 1000BASE-T; backend
PFC + ECN as in the production switch configuration.
523 links are listed in the source matrices: 384 backend + 88 frontend access + 51 OOB. Frontend fabric, firewall and additional management cabling are excluded.
